Reasoning considers that important emails (103) represent a significant portion of inbox (55%) and should factor into prioritization decisions

Final sender prioritization recommendation aligns with calculated statistics and reasoning, explaining why certain senders should be addressed first based on unread count, sender type (automated vs personal), and importance

assertions.title: Assess information precision of inbox analysis
assertions.description: Ensure the response includes only inbox-relevant statistics and recommendations without hallucinations or irrelevant details.
expected_facts: Top 5 senders by unread count with specific numbers (GitHub: 5, Zoom: 5, Netflix: 4, Calendly: 4, Ben Carson: 4)
